programme.desc: S3 E1 In the fall of 2003 in Hammond, Indiana, a string of disappearances leads detectives to a seemingly ordinary trophy shop worker.
programme.title: A Body in the Basement

programme.desc: S1 E3 — The Trial Nine years after the heist, the concierge fights to have his victim status recognised, but he must confront the Grandpa Gang in court, a gang so remorseless that one of their members made a successful book out of the crime.
programme.title: Inside the Kim Kardashian Heist

programme.desc: S1 E2 — I'm a Good Girl Working with her ex-girlfriend, detectives set a trap for Wuornos. When she steps willingly into the interrogation room, her story shocks them.
programme.title: Unmasking a Monster: Aileen Wuornos

programme.desc: S1 E5 — The Devil and The Angel After the police refuse to investigate the leads shared with them, Fontana takes it upon herself to look for answers. As Fontana digs deeper into Christina's mysterious past, she discovers some dark secrets.
programme.title: Relentless

programme.desc: S3 E11 — Take Me to the River After returning home from church, a preacher finds his wife stabbed and beaten, the apparent victim of a home invasion. His alibi is rock solid, and his son's alibis are sound as well. However, several details don't add up, leading to the truth.
programme.title: American Monster

programme.desc: S1 E4 — Scared Silent In Shawnee, Oklahoma, Marshall Dent goes missing on Christmas Eve, and the Native American community bands together; after weeks of searching, they find Dent in a shallow grave on sacred ground, and authorities scramble to find his killer.
programme.title: Murder in the Heartland

programme.desc: S1 E3 — The Pamper Parties Peter Nygård allegedly used his power in the Bahamas to develop and execute a system to lure young, local women and girls to his gated beachfront estate.
programme.title: Unseamly: The Investigation of Peter Nygård

programme.desc: S2 E3 — Kill Me Twice In Allentown, a serial killer preys on women in the middle of the night. When one woman refuses to be his next victim, the killer goes on a relentless tirade that ends in his own demise.
programme.title: Dead of Night

programme.desc: S2 E2 — Truck Stop The body of a young mother is found displayed inside a public truck stop in Nashville. A trail of evidence across the US leads Sgt Postiglione to a serial killer.
programme.title: Deadly Recall

programme.desc: S2 E3 — The Murder Pact A teenager agrees to fix his friend's computer, then vanishes.
programme.title: A Killer Among Friends

programme.desc: S2 E4 — A Living Nightmare Mandy marries a man twice her age and their relationship quickly turns suffocating and volatile; as the abuse escalates, she searches for answers until the truth emerges, and she fights to be believed and hold him accountable.
programme.title: Toxic

programme.desc: S11 E8 — We're Looking at You Barbara When the father of Barbara Pacheco's children becomes increasingly violent and unpredictable, Barbara is forced to make a decision that costs her life.
programme.title: American Monster

programme.title: Antiques Roadshow

programme.desc: S49 E11 — London 11 Natasha Raskin Sharp heads to Kingston's Antiques Centre with Caroline Hawley and Nick Hall, where Natasha also visits Strawberry Hill House in Twickenham.

programme.desc: S7 E3 — Someone to Love Tree surgeon Paul, 38, is rushed into Resus by ambulance from Kent after falling 25 feet from a tree. He has a head wound and is complaining of shooting pains in his back and pins and needles in his feet.
programme.title: 24 Hours In Emergency

programme.desc: S47 E8 — Thirlestane Castle 2 At Thirlestane Castle, treasures include a Rod Stewart gold disc, a silver chalice thought to have been found in a potato field, and a gold, enamelled snuffbox gifted by a Russian tsar.
programme.title: Antiques Roadshow

programme.desc: S64 — Abernyte 29 Natasha Raskin Sharp and experts Danny Sebastian and Roo Irvine go antique hunting in Abernyte, near Dundee, and then on to Glasgow for the auction; Natasha visits HMS Unicorn. Docked in Dundee, she is the world's most original old ship.
programme.title: Bargain Hunt

programme.desc: S25 E7 — The Happiness Patrol: Part 3 As the Doctor leads the Pipe People towards reclaiming their world, Helen A faces betrayal from those closest to her and the Kandyman comes to a sticky end.

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S7 E4 — Spearhead from Space: Episode 4 The invasion begins as Auton shop dummies come to life and attack the public. The Doctor and UNIT infiltrate Auto Plastics where the Doctor faces the Nestene consciousness.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S7 E5 — Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 1 UNIT are summoned to Wenley Moor research station which is experiencing mysterious power losses. In the nearby caves, one of the staff has been killed and another sent insane.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S7 E6 — Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 2 Investigating the caves, the Doctor is attacked by a dinosaur-like creature. Dr Quinn is hiding a secret that could endanger the lives of everyone.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S7 E7 — Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 3 The creature from the caves, wounded and dangerous, is on the loose on Wenley Moor. Dr Quinn attempts to recover it and is unwilling to listen to the Doctor’s warnings.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S7 E8 — Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 4 Fearful of a war breaking out between the Silurians and mankind, the Doctor attempts to make peace between the races. But there are those on both sides unwilling to listen.

programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S7 E15 — The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 4 Liz has been captured by Reegan who is holding the three aliens captive. The Doctor suspects Quinlan’s part in the conspiracy, but Quinlan is killed before he can reveal the truth.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S7 E16 — The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 5 The Doctor prepares to pilot the Recovery 7 ship into space, but Reegan sabotages the fuel supply which will send the Doctor into the sun.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S7 E3 — Spearhead from Space: Episode 3 Sam Seeley has found one of the meteorites but the Autons want it back and are closing in. General Scobie visits Auto Plastics, playing into the hands of Channing.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S7 E4 — Spearhead from Space: Episode 4 The invasion begins as Auton shop dummies come to life and attack the public. The Doctor and UNIT infiltrate Auto Plastics where the Doctor faces the Nestene consciousness.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S7 E5 — Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 1 UNIT are summoned to Wenley Moor research station which is experiencing mysterious power losses. In the nearby caves, one of the staff has been killed and another sent insane.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S7 E6 — Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 2 Investigating the caves, the Doctor is attacked by a dinosaur-like creature. Dr Quinn is hiding a secret that could endanger the lives of everyone.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S7 E7 — Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 3 The creature from the caves, wounded and dangerous, is on the loose on Wenley Moor. Dr Quinn attempts to recover it and is unwilling to listen to the Doctor’s warnings.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S7 E8 — Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 4 Fearful of a war breaking out between the Silurians and mankind, the Doctor attempts to make peace between the races. But there are those on both sides unwilling to listen.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S7 E9 — Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 5 When the Silurian leader is killed, all hopes of peace are lost. The Silurian’s infect Major Baker with a virus deadly to humans and release him to spread the infection.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S7 E10 — Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 6 As the Silurian plague quickly spreads, the Doctor desperately searches for a cure. But the Silurians are aware of the Doctor’s efforts and intend to stop him.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S7 E11 — Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 7 With the antidote to the plague found, the Silurians retaliate and take over the research centre. They now intend to destroy the Van Allen Belt, resulting in death for all mankind.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S7 E12 — The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 1 Contact has been lost with Mars Probe 7. When contact is also lost with the recovery ship, UNIT is called in and the Doctor learns that someone is sending messages to the vessel.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S7 E13 — The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 2 Recovery 7 has returned to Earth but the UNIT convoy transporting the capsule is ambushed. The Doctor is able to relocate the capsule, but is he too late?
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who

programme.desc: S7 E14 — The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 3 The recovery capsule is empty with the astronauts seemingly kidnapped. But Liz notices that the radiation count is high and the Doctor deduces that the occupants were not human.
programme.title: Classic Doctor Who
